subject: Insurance
title: The Death of Auto Insurance?
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Death of Auto Insurance?.

hook.text: If autonomous cars reduce accidents by 90%, auto insurance premiums could drop 80%.

buildup.text: Human error causes 94% of accidents. Remove the human, remove most accidents.

discovery.text: KPMG predicts the auto insurance industry will shrink 60% by 2040. McKinsey projects a similar decline.

twist.text: The transition period is dangerous for insurers.

climax.text: Auto insurance as we know it may not survive full autonomy.

quiz.question: How might autonomous vehicles affect auto insurance?
options: Drastically reduce accidents and shrink the market
